say:2:1041580602:1.text: Hm? Was that a bat fluttering past my ear just now? How tedious.
say:2:1041580602:1.source_cn: 咦，怎么好像有只蝙蝠从余耳边飞过？好吵。

say:3:1041580603:1.text: Pretending not to hear me won't work, Mother.
say:3:1041580603:1.source_cn: 装聋作哑也没用的，母亲大人。

say:4:1041580604:1.source_cn: ……能不能别提那个词，余亲爱的儿子？

say:5:1041580605:1.text: Keep your distance out in the open. I don't need you ruining my reputation, or Novaris'. Turning a few centuries old and siring you doesn't make me your mother.
say:5:1041580605:1.source_cn: 这称呼仅限于莫蒂默庄园内，在外还请你和余划清界限，不要...

say:6:1041580606:1.text: Besides, we're in Merlin's Mystical House. Even the Progenitor can't touch us here.
say:6:1041580606:1.source_cn: 何况这里是梅林的神秘屋。就算始祖把手伸得再长，也管不到...
say:6:1041580606:1.male: Besides, we're in Merlin's Mystical House. Even the Progenitor can't touch us here.
say:6:1041580606:1.female: Besides, we're in Merlin's Mystical House. Even the Progenitor can't touch us here.

say:7:1041580607:1.text: Heh. Shortening his name like that? Though I suppose such boldness comes naturally to you.
say:7:1041580607:1.source_cn: 呵呵，您竟然这么快就改口称“始祖”了。不愧是母亲大人。

say:8:1041580608:1.text: Though I suppose only you would have the nerve to speak so boldly. I'm of far more modest standing, and certainly lack the courage to challenge Lord Progenitor's authority.
say:8:1041580608:1.source_cn: 不过，这样的胆量也只有母亲大人您才拥有。在下人微言轻，...

say:9:1041580609:1.text: Drop the innocent act. There's nothing in this world you wouldn't dare do.
say:9:1041580609:1.source_cn: 少在余面前装傻卖乖。世间就没有你不敢做的事。

say:10:1041580610:1.text: If you were truly so timid, Twilight Pavilion would've closed its doors long ago, and I'd have hauled you back to Novaris to deal with these tedious affairs.
say:10:1041580610:1.source_cn: 若你真有那么怯懦，霁月会馆早就关门大吉，你也早被余抓回...

say:11:1041580611:1.text: Actually... if Merlin's Mystical House is so convenient, perhaps I should have all the paperwork sent here. You can take care of it from now on.
say:11:1041580611:1.source_cn: 说起来，既然梅林的神秘屋如此方便，不如余派人将公文悉数...
say:11:1041580611:1.male: Actually... if Merlin's Mystical House is so convenient, perhaps I should have all the paperwork sent here. You can take care of it from now on.
say:11:1041580611:1.female: Actually... if Merlin's Mystical House is so convenient, perhaps I should have all the paperwork sent here. You can take care of it from now on.

say:12:1041580612:1.text: If that is your wish, Sire, I would hardly refuse.
say:12:1041580612:1.source_cn: 若您执意如此，即便在下不愿，也无法拒绝。

say:13:1041580613:1.text: But while I'm stuck with paperwork, who's sifting through the intelligence at Twilight Pavilion? Lord Progenitor gave you final say on all of it before he went into slumber.
say:13:1041580613:1.source_cn: 只不过，霁月会馆中还有一些情报尚未呈报。始祖殿下又曾嘱...

say:15:1041580615:1.text: Did he? How strange. I don't remember that.
say:15:1041580615:1.source_cn: 有这回事？余怎么不记得。

say:16:1041580616:1.text: If you want me working, go wake him up and tell him to make me.
say:16:1041580616:1.source_cn: 若想让余工作，先把始祖唤醒再来讨论吧。

say:17:1041580617:1.text: Your boundaries certainly are flexible. One moment, you dismiss Lord Progenitor's rules, and the next, you invoke his authority to silence me.
say:17:1041580617:1.source_cn: 您的底线当真是随机应变。一边嫌弃始祖殿下制定的规矩，一...

say:19:1041580619:1.text: You're still young, little vampire. Give it a few centuries and you'll be more shameless than either of us. You clearly have the talent for it.
say:19:1041580619:1.source_cn: 你还太年轻了些，小吸血鬼。若你也活上几千年，肯定会比余...

say:20:1041580620:1.text: Otherwise, I wouldn't have chosen you to save all those years ago.
say:20:1041580620:1.source_cn: 若非如此，余当初可不会选你来救。明白吗？
